title: webhook-tester sessions bootstrap file
description: Defines sessions to be created automatically on startup if they do not already exist

id.description: Session UUID. Determines the webhook URL path

code.description: HTTP response status code returned to incoming webhook requests

headers.description: HTTP response headers returned to incoming webhook requests

body.description: HTTP response body. Accepts a plain string, a base64-encoded string, or an array of byte values (integers 0-255)

oneOf.description: Plain text or base64-encoded body. Base64 is decoded automatically; falls back to raw string if decoding fails
Raw bytes as an array of integers, each in the range [0, 255]

delay.description: Artificial delay before the response is sent. Accepts a number (seconds, e.g. 1.5 = 1s500ms) or a duration string (e.g. "500ms", "2s", "1m")

oneOf.description: Delay in seconds. Fractions are supported (e.g. 0.1 = 100ms)
Duration string accepted by Go's time.ParseDuration (e.g. "100ms", "5s", "1m30s")
